title: A TATTOO TILE IS A CLOSE-UP
why: Seen on the FASHION screenshot of 2026-10-07: the new TATTOO previews showed the whole small figure, so the ink could not be seen and every tattoo tile looked alike. Tattoos now get a close-up of the face, neck and tops of the arms, like the face and hairstyle tiles.
now: The FASHION tattoo tiles show the tattoo up close.
